root_cause: A provider check configured to run only for Supabase changes was required universally by branch protection, so correct provider skips deadlocked unrelated pull requests.
prevention: Require an always-running repository-owned applicability check universally.
Treat non-Supabase changes as explicit not-applicable success.
For Supabase changes require exact-head success from the provider-owned Supabase GitHub App.
Never manufacture a supabase/** change solely to obtain a provider check.
